rv.q: I'd happily have left during the interval. I'm glad I didn't.
It is a shame that the force and vivacity of the writing is stifled by direction that is too eager to please.
Baghdaddy is a sketchpad rather than an opus of trauma and frustrated affection.
At best Baghdaddy is a surreal trip into traumatic memory, at its worst it's a self-indulgent mess.
